name: Changeling after Curse of Conformity — still loses all creature types
notes: Found by the first conversion batch, confirmed by the owner 2026-10-05 after checking the rules. Changeling is a characteristic-defining ability, so it applies first in layer 4 regardless of timestamp (CR 613.3); Curse of Conformity then removes every creature type. The Changeling is added AFTER the Curse here, so plain timestamp order would wrongly leave it with every creature type.
